title: Epispastic
summary: EPISPAS'TIC, adjective [Gr. to draw.] In medicine, drawing; attracting the humors to the skin; exciting action in the skin; blistering. EPISPAS'TIC, noun A topical remedy, applied to the external part

inlines.v: EPISPAS'TIC, adjective [Gr. to draw.] In medicine, drawing; attracting the humors to the skin; exciting action in the skin; blistering. EPISPAS'TIC, noun A topical remedy, applied to the external part of the body, for the purpose of drawing the humors to the part, or exciting action in the skin; a blister.
